title: Classic Mini Ballet Barre Workout | Sleek Ballet Fitness
description:
This classic mini ballet barre workout is great for beginners and even advanced exercisers to do at home. Just grab a chair and easily follow along with professional dancer and Sleek co-founder, Flik Swan, as she leads you through a series of exercises that will shape and tone your legs and butt in just 20 minutes. This can be done every day and only requires a small space at home.
